shots.focal_element: The product lockup (palette icon + 'Design', then 'by Anthropic Labs'), which resolves into the Claude spark and 'Claude' wordmark
shots.transition_other: Continuation of the s029 card wall: the project windows drift outward/fade away around a palette icon left at centre (anchors: other)
shots.typography: 'Design' in a medium-weight sentence-case sans beside an outline palette icon; 'by Anthropic Labs' as a small regular-weight sans subline, centred under it; final 'Claude' wordmark in a bold sentence-case serif with normal tracking next to the spark mark. Font guesses (low confidence): Styrene-like sans for the product name, Anthropic's Claude serif wordmark.
shots.what_happens: The last project windows clear from the wall, leaving a palette icon at centre; 'Design' appears beside it to form the product lockup, which shifts up as 'by Anthropic Labs' fades in beneath (around 1:14.5). The lockup holds, then clears to the Claude spark alone (1:16.0), and 'Claude' appears beside it (1:16.5). The Claude wordmark then holds still on the flat off-white field until the video ends at 1:21.5.
shots.build_rebuild: On a flat off-white stage, fade the outer project cards out around a centred palette icon, slide-in the 'Design' label to its right, nudge the group up ~15 px while fading in a small 'by Anthropic Labs' subline, then crossfade to the spark mark alone and reveal the 'Claude' wordmark beside it, holding the final lockup for ~5 s.

hook.text: A 'Design' pill is clicked and morphs into a prompt card; a request for an interactive dark globe graphic types in, files are attached, Send is pressed and the globe builds itself behind a 'Designing...' status pill.

summary.tone: Calm, confident and crafted: warm off-white minimalism, music-only (no voice-over), with the product itself telling the story through typed prompts and one continuous camera; an understated brand sign-off instead of a hard sell.

signature_moments.description: The opening 'Design' pill morphs into the prompt card, which later collapses into a shimmering italic-serif status pill while the globe draws itself behind it.
signature_moments.why_premium: One UI element is carried through several states by shape morphs rather than cuts, so the prompt-to-result loop reads as one continuous gesture and the product feels alive.

signature_moments.description: A single virtual camera travels across a wall of project windows, dives into one workspace, macro-zooms onto toolbar buttons and pulls back out to the wall to move to the next project.
signature_moments.why_premium: Building the whole film as one spatial canvas gives continuity and a sense of scale (many projects) that ordinary screen recordings with cuts cannot.

signature_moments.description: The comment 'Make this a line graph instead?' is sent and the selected bar chart morphs bar-by-bar into a drawn line graph.
signature_moments.why_premium: The request and its result are shown back to back with a data-aware morph, making the AI edit feel instant and precise instead of a page reload.

hook.evidence: Opens directly on the product with a cursor click, a pill-to-card morph and a typed prompt that resolves into a glowing globe within ~11 s; strong and muted-friendly, but there is no stated claim or problem, so the 'why' is implicit.

clarity.evidence: Each feature is introduced by clicking a labelled toolbar button in macro close-up (Tweaks, Comment, Knobs, Edit text, Export) followed by its visible result, so the workflow is easy to follow; without voice-over or captions, the value proposition and feature names are never stated beyond UI labels.

ui_showcase.evidence: Rich, legible recreated UI across several projects (globe landing page, meditation app, offsite guide, feature deck), with real states: agent checklist, tweak sliders, theme toggle, property panel, export menu and handoff modal.

motion_polish.evidence: Shape morphs between UI states, continuous camera moves through one canvas with motion blur on fast zooms, shimmer text loaders, a chart morph and a restrained logo resolve; a cut detector even split continuous moves into separate shots.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from the audio facts in anchors, not listening: a music bed at 105.47 BPM with beats detected through ~75.8 s, integrated loudness -13.06 LUFS, and 65 SFX candidates, but most are labelled music or unsure with low CLAP scores, so distinct UI sounds are not confirmed; a swoosh_reverse candidate (x065) lands as the end lockup builds. Competent and loud enough for social, but no clear evidence of a crafted SFX layer.

vo_script_quality.evidence: No voice-over: the anchors transcript is empty, so a script score does not apply.

brand_consistency.evidence: Consistent warm off-white field, the same sans/italic-serif pairing for UI and status loaders, accent-filled pressed states throughout, the spark mark on loaders, and a closing 'Design by Anthropic Labs' then Claude lockup.

works_muted.evidence: There is no voice-over, so all of the story is carried by typed prompts, labelled buttons and visible results; nothing is lost with sound off.

overall.evidence: A best-in-class motion and UI piece that turns one continuous canvas into a tour of the prompt, tweak, comment, edit and export loop and ends on a clean brand lockup; it loses a point because it never states the value proposition and gives no explicit CTA (no URL or availability line).

localization_friendliness.notes: No voice-over or caption track to translate; all text is baked into the recreated UI mocks (prompts, toolbar labels, chat answers, slide copy) and the end lockup, so a localized version means re-rendering the mocks with translated strings and re-timing the typing animations. Leaving the UI in English would still be understandable.
